title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: The owners meetings are today and tomorrow in Chicago. Who is representing the team?
██l I know is that ██ will be there...
Can I quote you on that?
You know from past meetings that he attends and I am sure you have written that. Write it as matter of fact. ██ has gone before and Dave use to attend previously.
I cannot write for a fact he is attending if I don't know for a fact if he is attending.
So then why didn't you just say that?
███████, ██ is attending as he has since he assumed his position.
I'm asking who, with ownership, is representing the team.
